company.name: AI Proctor
company.shortDescription: AI Proctor is a proctoring system that helps instructors and students to set proctoring options and online assessments for exams.
company.description: AI Proctor is a tech company that develops proctoring software for online exam assessments. The company's platform provides real-time monitoring and browser monitoring, and it works even during internet outages and power outages thanks to artificial intelligence, allowing clients to monitor students during assessments. It consists of a web application used by the examiner to configure proctoring options and add the exam link or upload exam questions, a desktop application for the test taker that acts as a secure browser, and an optional mobile app companion to proctor the student using the mobile camera in addition to the laptop camera.
